result.stdout:
Description:
  Build, test, and debug your AI coding environment like software.

Usage:
  axm [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  doctor    Check the vault's health: list every asset, then every problem.
  validate  Check every asset and print only the problems, for CI and hooks.
  list      List the vault's assets by kind, with maturity, version and harness support.
  hook      Hooks for Claude Code to run. Each reads the hook's JSON on stdin.

Options:
  --root <root>                                         The vault to check. Defaults to the current directory. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-axioma-a4989e93-c641800a]
  --kind <agent|experiment|hook|policy|skill|workflow>  Only this kind of asset.
  --harness <claude-code|codex|copilot|generic>         Only assets that support this harness, and how well.
